scope: World-owned parked vehicle presentation, exact imported mesh/LOD reuse, bounded native publication and production loading gate. Not the full overhaul, dense real-car GPU qualification or seamless shadow transitions.
implementation: Original 0BSD native code/tests using existing project meshes, materials and dependencies. No new external dependency, proxy asset or compute shader. Native changed-ID bookkeeping and engine GPU instancing/imported mesh LODs.

fixture.policy: Read-only source, four in-memory Rangers; component binary injected into second world's production loading gate. No new clone or disk compound-save test. Offscreen/nonactivating; no OS mouse capture.

bounds.scope: No object-distance retirement. Frustum/occlusion/clipping/fog still apply. Synchronous near/full-body exclusion handoffs are separately bounded by identity capacity, not the background three-page limit; dense handoff latency remains unqualified.

native_checks.scope: One box prototype. Exact transforms/materials, idle no-scan/no-upload, state-only changes, exclusion atomicity, cross-cell transactions, packed removal, module separation, restore and observer teardown. GPU buffer validation uses rendered Vulkan; not full-car draw/GPU endurance.

installed_world.scope: Two world instances; component restoration, not disk compound-save. Frozen test poses use terrain samples plus 0.85 m; wheel contact is not qualified. Distant manual camera retains normal fog, not production overview visual approval. Sampled peaks on current hardware, not 4 GiB hardware qualification.

actual_car_cost_baseline.scope: Isolated real-Ranger rendering, 1080p/60 cap, no terrain/shadow casting/driving. Six fixed-camera phases, 60 warmup and 120 measured frames each; images inspected. Functional success is not frame-time acceptance. A 76.601 ms close-view frame remains unexplained; no attribution to focus, driver or native code without evidence. Raw primitive counters are engine-dependent, not submitted instance triangle totals.
actual_car_cost_baseline.next: Evaluate exact per-material prototype consolidation: 32 mesh parts share one material. Retain transforms, vertex attributes and imported LOD behavior; compare identical scenes, then populated-world handoff and driving/zoom. No geometry consolidation implemented by this test commit.
actual_car_cost_baseline.uid_import: reports/vehicle_horizon_cost_import.log; Godot generated the sidecar. Existing nested ZombieLab project and three duplicate paving-test UIDs in retained rejected-ramp evidence produced warnings; not changed here.
